newsitem.title: CHINA: HK customs arrest 80, seize fake CDs.
newsitem.headline: HK customs arrest 80, seize fake CDs.

text.p: Hong Kong officials have arrested 82 people and seized HK$7 million (US$900,000) worth of fake compact discs after a two-day sweep, its customs authority said on Monday.
More than 100 customs officers took part in raids on shops suspected of selling pirated CDs, video compact discs and TV games.
In May, customs officers seized pirated compact discs worth HK$4.6 million.
Hong Kong is well-known for counterfeit products and has been put on the special watch list of the United States Trade Representative's office.
Last year, Hong Kong conducted more than 1,000 raids and seized about one million counterfeit CDs worth an estimated HK$47 million.
